notes.title: About Escape Lala 2
notes.content:
Dear and beloved players Hello, 
we are often asked if the next game in the series is longer than the first game.
And the answer is - of course! It is significantly longer and significantly cute!
We'd be happy to answer any questions you may have

notes.title: Escape Lala 2 is Now Available!
notes.content:
After a long time of development, we are finally happy to announce that Escape Lala 2 is now available on Steam!

It is the second adventure in the Escape Lala games series, with a new large world full of secrets and mysteries waiting to be uncovered by you!

“Our beloved princess is missing… What happened? Discover the world of Escape Lala 2, solve mysteries, uncover secrets and bring back peace and order to the world.”


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079450/Escape_Lala_2__Retro_Point_and_Click_Adventure/
